translation: A letter has come from your in-laws' house, son
My boy, oh boy, my little boy
A letter has come from your in-laws' house, son
My boy, oh boy, my little boy
If a letter comes from my in-laws' house, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
If a letter comes from my in-laws' house, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
You board the bus at Nampally, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
Once I board the bus at Nampally, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
You get off the bus at Uppal, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
Once I get off at Choutuppal, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
Your brother-in-law will come there and take you home
Your mother-in-law will come out to meet you, son.. oh my, oh dear!
She will give you water in a pot, and you must wash your feet
And after washing my feet, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
After I wash my feet, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
Aha, then your mother-in-law, glad her son-in-law has come after so long,
will lovingly take you into a room, set down a low stool and serve you a meal
You silly simpleton, you must eat
And after eating, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
After I eat, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
Aha, then comes your darling wife, son
She will take you into the room, you silly simpleton
You must lie down, son
And after lying down, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
After I lie down, what do you want me to do?
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
At that moment, at that very minute
At that moment, at that very minute
What if she pinches me, what if she scratches me, what if she grabs me
What if she pushes me down? I'm scared, mother!
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
What if she pinches, scratches, grabs me
What if she pushes me down? I'm scared, mother!
Oh mother, my mother, my dear mother
Chhee, you foolish son of mine!
Go face the east and fold your hands in prayer, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
Go face the east and fold your hands in prayer, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
Go face the east and fold your hands in prayer, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
Go face the east and fold your hands in prayer, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
Go face the east and fold your hands in prayer, son
Oh boy, my boy, my little boy
summaryEn:
A comic dialogue song between a mother and her grown but naive son, sung by M. Narasima Murthy and R. Chayadevi on the album Janapada Geethalu (Folk Songs, 2004). A letter has come from the son's in-laws, and the mother walks her "bujji babu" (little boy) through the visit step by step: board the bus at Nampally, get off at Uppal or Choutuppal, where his brother-in-law will meet him; his mother-in-law will hand him water to wash his feet, lovingly seat him on a low stool and serve him a meal; then his wife will lead him into the room. After every instruction the son asks, "And then what do you want me to do, mother?"

The humour grows out of this repeated question. Told to lie down, the son panics that his wife might pinch, scratch or push him, and the exasperated mother snaps "Chhee!" and tells him to face the east and fold his hands, which appears to be the Telugu idiom for giving up on someone as hopeless. The song teases an innocent groom and shows the hospitality shown to a son-in-law. Its strict call-and-response form is marked by the refrains "naa baabu, o baabu" and "oyammo maayamma".

అమాయకుడైన కొడుకుకీ, అతని తల్లికీ మధ్య సాగే హాస్య సంభాషణ గీతం ఇది. M. నరసింహ మూర్తి, R. ఛాయాదేవి పాడిన ఈ పాట 2004 నాటి 'Janapada Geethalu (Folk Songs)' ఆల్బమ్‌లోనిది. అత్తారింటి నుంచి ఉత్తరం వచ్చిందని తల్లి చెప్పగానే, ఆ తర్వాత ఏం చేయాలని కొడుకు అడుగుతూనే ఉంటాడు. తల్లి ఓపికగా ఒక్కో మెట్టూ వివరిస్తుంది: నాంపల్లిలో బస్సెక్కాలి, ఉప్పల్/చౌటుప్పల్ దగ్గర దిగాలి, అక్కడికి బావమరిది వచ్చి ఇంటికి తీసుకెళ్తాడు; అత్తగారు చెంబుతో నీళ్ళిస్తే కాళ్ళు కడుక్కోవాలి; ఎంతో కాలానికి వచ్చిన అల్లుడని ఆమె ప్రేమగా పీట వేసి భోజనం పెడుతుంది; ఆ తర్వాత ముద్దుల పెళ్ళాం గదిలోకి తీసుకెళ్తుంది.

ప్రతి దశ తర్వాత 'నన్నేం జేయమంటావే' అని కొడుకు అడిగే ప్రశ్నే హాస్యానికి మూలం. పడుకోవాలని చెప్పగానే, భార్య గిల్లుతుందేమో, రక్కుతుందేమో, కిందకి తోసేస్తుందేమో అని భయపడిపోతాడు. విసిగిపోయిన తల్లి 'ఛీ నా కొడకా' అంటూ 'తూర్పుకెళ్ళి దండం పెట్టరా' అని ముగిస్తుంది — ఇక నీతో లాభం లేదనే అర్థంలో వాడే నానుడిలా ఇది కనిపిస్తుంది. సంసారం గురించి ఏమీ తెలియని అమాయక అల్లుడిని ఈ పాట ఆటపట్టిస్తుంది; అల్లుడికి కాళ్ళకు నీళ్ళివ్వడం, పీట వేసి భోజనం పెట్టడం వంటి ఆతిథ్య ఆచారాలూ కనిపిస్తాయి. 'నా బాబు ఓ బాబు', 'ఓయమ్మో మాయమ్మ' అనే పల్లవులతో ప్రశ్నోత్తర రూపంలో పాట సాగుతుంది.
